description:
Jeong Nan-Woo, a world-renowned violin prodigy, overcame a troubled childhood to rise to global fame. Yet despite his success, he remains trapped in layers of emotional darkness he can’t seem to escape. Enoch Milligan, a charming Hollywood heartthrob known more for his looks than his acting skills, is desperate to prove himself as more than just a pretty face. The two seem to share nothing in common—until a film project brings them together. Enoch is cast as the lead in a movie based on Nan-Woo’s life and insists on shadowing him to prepare for the role, ignoring Nan-Woo’s initial discomfort. As Enoch stays by his side—warm, passionate, and unexpectedly gentle—Nan-Woo’s walls slowly begin to crack. The closer they grow, the more Nan-Woo begins to rediscover beauty, trust, and a light he thought he’d lost forever. Sometimes, healing begins with simply letting someone in.

(Source: Lezhin US)
